<td class="text">This
Current Report on Form 8-K/A (this &#8220;Report&#8221;) amends the Current Report on Form 8-K filed with the U.S. Securities
and Exchange Commission (the &#8220;SEC&#8221;) on August 6, 2026 (the &#8220;Original 8-K&#8221;) by BioKey (Cayman),
Inc. (the &#8220;Company&#8221;) disclosing that on August 1, 2026, the audit committee of the board of directors (the &#8220;Board&#8221;)
of the Company dismissed Simon & Edward LLP (&#8220;S&E&#8221;) as the Company&#8217;s independent registered public accounting
firm and approved the engagement of Kreit & Chiu CPA LLP (&#8220;KC&#8221;) as its new independent registered public accounting
firm.<span></span>
</td>
